title: Azusawa Kohane — I'll Tell You Lots!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Today's event takes place at a live house in the city.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's one of the most famous venues in the country, so the people who perform there are the best of the best.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which means you'll probably recognize some of today's participants. That all being said, you guys have what it takes to go up against them now. So go show them what you've got!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This really is an event for the best of the best. But we're doing just fine.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(We have what it takes now!
We just gotta show them what we're made of!!!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wh-What's he doing here...?
No, wait! I need to stay focused!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Kohane, there you are!
Did you get to see your dad?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So...
My dad insisted that he wanted to greet all of you and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: Long time no see, Shiraishi, Shinonome, Aoyagi. Thank you for always looking after Kohane.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, uhh...!
It's always our pleasure!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry for making you find us like this.
We should've been the ones looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: No, I couldn't ask that of you all! I know you must be tired... I mean, what a performance!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
We're glad to hear that you enjoyed everything.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
You also put on quite a performance!
Bravo!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Ah, Azusawa, I didn't realize you were here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: Oh, Shiraishi... Sorry for dropping in all of a sudden. I got the afternoon off from work and just happened to be nearby, so...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I see. Thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Your dad and my dad are just talking, An, but it feels so weird for some reason...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know what you mean...
I'm starting to get really anxious.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's pretty understandable...
I mean, you never know what your parents are gonna say...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You never know...
Please don't say anything weird, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know how you feel, Azusawa, but I wouldn't worry too much. I'm sure he isn't going to embarrass you in any way...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, thank you again for keeping an eye on her today.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Of course. Also, please stop by again if you get the chance.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We can do our debrief later, so why don't you see your dad out first?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
In that case, I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See you in a bit, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Dad, why didn't you tell me that you were coming today...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
I had a feeling you'd say that.
I couldn't help but come and I really just happened to be nearby.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Please give me a little more warning next time since I can probably get a ticket ready for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
Today's event was really something else.
The audience cheered so loudly that it made my ears hurt...

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
I even ended up shouting, “Kohane!”
It's been so long since I yelled at the top of my lungs like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, umm...
I heard you, Dad.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: But I'm glad you're doing what you love.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
Shiraishi told me just now...
It's wonderful to see you chasing after your dream like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
And you were so cool today!
It must've felt incredible to sing like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line: Anyway, thanks for seeing me out.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Uhh...
There's something I've been meaning to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for allowing me to continue singing and giving me so much support.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I'm causing you and Mom a lot of concern, but I really appreciate you letting me chase after my dream like this...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm able to focus on that every day, which is hard sometimes... But really fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane's Father
rows.Line:
Keep doing your best, Kohane!
I'll keep giving you all the support I can!
